title: deactivate-reply
description: POST /api/v1/devices/deactivate 200 reply. Idempotent: deactivating an already deactivated register returns the same reply.

apiKeyRevoked.description: true when the main till released itself: the branch key stops working now.

transferCode.description: Per-till licences (the portal's choice, 2026-09-30): null — the same licence key is activated again on the new PC and messages[] says so; the till shows that text and never treats null as an error. A one-time code is still accepted (branch model): the till shows it once with Copy.

messages.description: When transferCode is null, put the next step here (e.g. "Activate this same licence key on the new PC"): the till shows it straight after Deactivate. None sent: the till says to enter the same licence key on the new PC.
